afterImage.name: Intermountain Infrastructure Group, LLC
afterImage.description: Intermountain Infrastructure Group, LLC develops, owns and operates long-haul and regional fiber networks, offering dark fiber, wavelengths, high-capacity internet and colocation. The U.S.-headquartered platform is building and operating routes across the western and northern United States, with Canada as a secondary market. Its Northern Tier system is a wholly owned multi-conduit route designed to connect the Pacific Northwest with the Minneapolis area, while other routes serve the Inland Northwest and Northern Rockies. Wafra and Post Road announced their investment in February 2023 and completed the recapitalization on January 12, 2024 through WRA II-Pioneer (S) LLC and PRSOF II IIG Inc. Future Standard later succeeded Post Road as manager of the digital-infrastructure platform. IIG identified Wafra as its majority shareholder and Future Standard as its other backer in June 2026; current exact ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.
